description: Portfolio and asset risk/return analytics from price or return series you supply: annualised return (CAGR) and volatility, Sharpe and Sortino ratios, max drawdown, historical and parametric 95% VaR, beta/alpha against a benchmark series and a correlation matrix, for each asset and the weighted (periodically rebalanced) portfolio. Up to 20 assets. POST JSON body. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/portfolio-metrics

benchmark.description: Name of the series to use as benchmark for beta/alpha (excluded from the portfolio unless weighted)

periodsPerYear.description: 252 trading days, 365 crypto days, 52 weeks, 12 months

prices.description: Price series per asset, oldest first: {"BTC":[...],"ETH":[...]} (same length)

returns.description: Alternatively periodic simple returns per asset as decimals (0.01 = 1%)

weights.description: Portfolio weights per asset (normalised; default equal)

name: portfolio_metrics
title: Portfolio Metrics
